data.name: PlaceToompeaShort
data.value: A medieval center of power with views of the old town.

data.name: PlaceToompeaDetail
data.value: Toompea Castle is one of Tallinn's most important historic sites. It houses the Estonian parliament, and nearby viewpoints give a beautiful look over the old town.

data.name: PlaceOldTownShort
data.value: The heart of the old town with cafes and historic houses.

data.name: PlaceOldTownDetail
data.value: Town Hall Square is the center of Tallinn's old town. Narrow cobblestone streets begin here, markets are held here, and it is a good starting point for a walk.

data.name: PlaceKadriorgShort
data.value: A peaceful park with a palace, museums, and flower gardens.

data.name: PlaceKadriorgDetail
data.value: Kadriorg Park is perfect for a calm walk. The park has Kadriorg Palace, nearby KUMU, ponds, and avenues that make it one of Tallinn's best loved green areas.

data.name: PlacePiritaShort
data.value: A seaside path for walking and cycling.

data.name: PlacePiritaDetail
data.value: Pirita Promenade brings together sea air, city views, and active movement. It is a good place for a morning run, bike ride, or relaxed evening walk.

data.name: PlaceMarketShort
data.value: A lively market with street food and local flavors.

data.name: PlaceMarketDetail
data.value: Balti Jaama Market combines fresh food, street food, cafes, and small shops. It works well for a quick lunch or for discovering local flavors.

data.name: PlaceTelliskiviShort
data.value: Cafes, restaurants, art, and a creative atmosphere.

data.name: PlaceTelliskiviDetail
data.value: Telliskivi Creative City is a popular area with restaurants, galleries, design shops, and events. It is a good choice when you want to see Tallinn's modern side.
